shots.intent: 承接搜索点击：一双鞋错落立于大理石台座上，用大字位与空胶囊一秒给出核心主张

shots.intent: 把核心利益拆成六格象形主张带，通栏墨底一屏读完，承接首屏后的一眼说服

shots.intent: 给买家可选感：两个款式位对角并置，色块胶囊留空由商品真值决定，不写任何配色名

shots.intent: 解释分层结构如何工作：三层薄片面揭开悬浮并配上升箭头，只给结构不给功效数值

shots.intent: 以微距压纹与走线做质感实证，只用掠射光还原参考品自身纹理，不补任何工艺断言

shots.intent: 消除规格疑虑但只给结构：双栏空参数行、空换算网格与空量脚条，全部数值留白

shots.textZone: one short unfilled caption beneath each of the four plates plus a headline block at the top

shots.intent: 收口：两双并置回扣首屏台面语言，只给一个空的强调色行动胶囊位，不写任何优惠事实

style.backgroundSystem: strict two-field rhythm that alternates a gypsum-paper field #EDEBE6 and a full-bleed graphite-slate information band #23272A on consecutive screens; the light field may carry a crisp satin sweep #F2F1EE with hard-edged diagonal fold ripples and two out-of-focus feathered frond corners
style.direction: premium business-casual footwear detail page, plaster-light field against full-bleed graphite information bands
style.iconSystem: two icon dialects kept separate and never mixed: solid frosted-steel #AEB6BC pictographs in a two-row three-column band divided by hairline vertical rules, and hollow circle line icons in a row of three above the sole screen; plus dot-and-leader hairlines into hollow pill labels, blank indicator wedges and one uninscribed badge outline
style.lightingSystem: bright cool studio grade, soft key from upper-left with a large fill card, hairline rim on dark fields, soft contact shadow that always grounds the product, faint floor reflection only where the sole faces the camera, no hard hotspots and no floating product
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium business-casual footwear commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a gypsum-paper field #EDEBE6, a full-bleed graphite-slate information band #23272A, frosted steel grey #AEB6BC and one botanical sage accent #6F8C6A; cool studio grade; strict two-field rhythm that alternates the light gypsum field with the graphite information band on consecutive screens; light field carries a crisp satin sweep #F2F1EE with hard-edged diagonal fold ripples, the only riser is a cool marble slab #DADAD5 with faint grey veining, the only soft props are two out-of-focus feathered frond corners; bright cool studio key from upper-left with a large fill card, hairline rim on dark fields, soft contact shadow grounding the product, faint floor reflection only on the sole-facing screen; single thin geometric sans-serif family with left-aligned headline blocks; solid frosted-steel pictograph band and hollow circle line icons kept as separate dialects, dot-and-leader hairlines into hollow pill labels, blank indicator wedges and one uninscribed badge outline as the only infographic components; product always presented off-foot and off-body at stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no on-foot or model shots, no legible brand marks, no prices or size numerals.
noDrift: no on-foot wear, legs or human body in any screen
no legible brand lettering, badge wording, prices or size numerals
style.presentationRules: the product is always shown off-foot and off-body on a neutral field at a stable scale, a pair staged at two different heights for the opening screen, one unit in a clean side profile for annotation, one unit sole-face toward the camera for tread proof; variant slots inherit their fills from the reference product instead of naming colours
style.surfaceSystem: one cool marble slab #DADAD5 with faint grey veining as the only riser, plain satin sweep #F2F1EE and gypsum board #EDEBE6 elsewhere, empty light-grey plate #C9C8C3 reserved for unloaded image slots
style.typography: single thin geometric sans-serif family, left-aligned headline block plus one small kicker line, all in-image wording reduced to placeholders, hairline rules and unfilled capsules instead of body text
